models.name: economic_discussion_board_guests
models.description: Anonymous guest users who can browse and view published articles, comments, and attachments without requiring authentication or registration. Guests represent the general public accessing economic and political discussion content. This table tracks guest-level interactions and access patterns for platform analytics, though guests have no personal information or managed entities.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created for tracking access patterns.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to mark inactive guest records.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_members
models.description: Registered member users who can create articles with attachments, post comments, and participate actively in economic and political discussions. Members have authenticated accounts with secure password-based login and can manage their own content independently. They represent the core community of contributors who require email verification and session management for platform access and content creation permissions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Member's email address used for authentication and account management. Must be unique across all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Stored using industry-standard hashing algorithms.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to mark deactivated member accounts while preserving content history.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_admins
models.description: Administrator users with elevated permissions to manage platform content, moderate inappropriate material, and oversee user accounts. Admins have authenticated accounts with secure login and can perform administrative actions across all platform content including articles, comments, and user management. They maintain platform integrity and community standards through content review and moderation capabilities.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator's email address used for authentication and account management. Must be unique across all administrators.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Stored using industry-standard hashing algorithms.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp to mark removed administrator accounts.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for member users, tracking login activity and connection details for security monitoring and audit purposes. Sessions are managed through member login/logout processes and include connection metadata for platform security. Each session expires after inactivity or explicit logout, ensuring secure access control for member accounts.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the member logged in.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where the login session originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for tracking login source.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created at login.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_admin_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for administrator users, recording login details and administrative access for security auditing and system monitoring. Admin sessions track critical platform access and include connection information for compliance and security review. Sessions automatically expire and are audited for administrative accountability.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrator logged in.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where the administrative login originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for tracking administrative login source.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative session expired.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_articles
models.description: Core content unit where members publish articles on economic and political topics. Each article serves as the foundation for discussion, containing title and body text that can be enhanced with various attachments for supporting evidence and data.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Authenticated member who created this article. {@link economic_discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title limited to 200 characters for concise topic identification.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main article content supporting rich text formatting and up to 10,000 characters for comprehensive economic analysis.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Publication status indicating article state: draft, pending (awaiting moderation), published (visible to all), rejected (moderation denied).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for removed articles.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_attachments
models.description: Supporting materials attached to articles, including images and documents that provide visual evidence or data sources for economic discussions. Each attachment belongs to exactly one article.

foreignFields.name: economic_discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Associated article this attachment supports. {@link economic_discussion_board_articles.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Original filename of the uploaded attachment.

plainFields.name: path
plainFields.description: Storage path or URL where the attachment file is located.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: File type of the attachment (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf').

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes for storage management.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was uploaded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was last modified.

models.name: economic_discussion_board_comments
models.description: User comments on published articles enabling threaded discussions and community engagement. Each comment belongs to a specific article and is created by an authenticated member through their active session. Comments can have parent references to create nested reply threads up to 3 levels deep. Members can edit their own comments after posting, and administrators can moderate inappropriate content through soft deletion. Comments appear immediately upon submission but may be moderated by admins, maintaining chronological ordering within discussion threads.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment's {@link economic_discussion_board_comments.id} for threaded replies.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment text content with maximum length of 2000 characters for meaningful discussion contributions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was first created and published.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last modified by the author.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for moderated content removal while preserving audit trails.
